record.question: Which amongst the following would not be hit by Spes Successionis?
options: A dies leaving a widow B and brother C. Transfer executed by C of property he will succeed to in case he survives B.
A daughter C who for a consideration of Rs. 5 lakhs paid by her father A executes a release of her right to share in the inheritance to A's property.
A believing his brother B to be dead transfers his enjoyment and possession of the property of B in dispute.
The right of a reversionary heir expectant on the death of a Hindu widow.
